title: Joan Gilligan Carroll Exhibits in Harwich Port
paragraphs: Joan Gilligan Carroll, oil and watercolor painter, is the featured artist for November at the Cape Cod 5 in Harwich Port. Her coastal and landscape paintings are frequently sketched and painted on location. She is a member of the Art Gallery in Harwich Port which is a division of the Art Guild of Harwich Artists. She previously taught art in the Braintree Public Schools for 35 years where she also served as Art Curriculum Director. Her work can be viewed during regular banking hours.

pwsbuilder November 1, 2018
Joan Gilligan Carroll, oil and watercolor painter, is the featured artist for November at the Cape Cod 5 in Harwich Port. Her coastal and landscape paintings are frequently sketched and painted on location. She is a member of the Art Gallery in Harwich Port which is a division of the Art Guild of Harwich Artists. She previously taught art in the Braintree Public Schools for 35 years where she also served as Art Curriculum Director. Her work can be viewed during regular banking hours.
